args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark)
args.body:
June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark (Covey & Lark Retail) on 16 Feb.
- "PHL" is also used for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal), so filtering on PHL returns both accounts. Pellow Home Living is the Mid-Atlantic home goods account.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It should be relabelled to Pellow Home Living.

Sofia
